lesson: Four verified defects from the round-1 quality lens, all confirmed against the code before being handed back. (1) P1, saved.service.ts selectionStatus: it checks permissions.domains/measureIds/dimensionIds but NOT permissions.actions.includes('report'), which selectionExecutor.authorize:109 DOES require for a composed domain - so a stored selection is reported runnable:true to a caller who would get a 403 on execution, which is exactly what t-aea-c4 forbids. Mirror authorize()'s condition exactly, including the composed-domain gating, so the listing's answer and the executor's answer cannot disagree. (2) P2, saved.schemas.ts:52 and the matching pins DTO: @ApiProperty({type:'object'}) makes the central selection payload opaque, so a generated client cannot see domain, measureIds, dimensionIds or filters. Decision 0019's non-deviated half requires named typed DTOs and documented Swagger; describe the selection shape rather than emitting a bare object. (3) P2, pins.controller.ts and saved.controller.ts: @Param('id') id: string reaches a uuid column unvalidated, so a malformed id raises 'invalid input syntax for type uuid' and returns 500 on routes that document a typed 400 - validate the path parameter. (4) P2, exploration-audit.filter.test.ts: it proves only the happy path. The filter's fail-closed branch (catch (auditError) -> fallback, refusal NOT reported) is untested, and t-aea-c6 requires the fail-closed audit on a DENIED branch specifically.
